# Part 1


## Objective


## Load packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(gt)
```

## Import data 

```{r}
# Read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("eds223-hw2", "data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# Check ejscreen crs
st_crs(ejscreen)

# Filter to LA County
los_angeles <- ejscreen |> 
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA") |> 
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Los Angeles County"))

# Read in json file
redline <- sf::st_read(here::here("eds223-hw2", "data", "mapping-inequality", "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"))

# Check that the CRS matches for ejscreen and redline
if(st_crs(redline) == st_crs(ejscreen)) {
  print("CRS matches") 
} else {
  warning('CRS does not match')
  print(paste('redline CRS is', st_crs(redline)))
  print(paste('ejscreen CRS is', st_crs(ejscreen)))
}

# Update redline crs to match ejscreen and run the test again 
redline <-st_transform(redline, 3857)

# Check that the CRS matches for ejscreen and redline
if(st_crs(redline) == st_crs(ejscreen)) {
  print("CRS matches") 
} else {
  warning('CRS does not match')
  print(paste('redline CRS is', st_crs(redline)))
  print(paste('ejscreen CRS is', st_crs(ejscreen)))
}
```


## Visualize data

```{r}
  # Create a map of historical redlining neighborhoods, including neighborhoods colored by HOLC grade, an appropriate base map, a clear title and legend 

tm_shape(redline) +
  tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
  tm_polygons() + 
  tm_fill(
    fill = "grade",
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "HOLC grade", position = tm_pos_out("right"))
  ) +
  tm_title(text = "Historical Redlining Neighborhoods in Los Angeles, CA") +
  tm_compass() +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_credits("Figure 1", position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom"));
```

```{r}
# Join LA and redline spatial data to create a summary
la_redline <- st_join(los_angeles, redline, join = st_intersects)

# Create the summary data frame 
la_block_groups <- la_redline |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  mutate(Grade = grade) |> 
  group_by(Grade) |> 
  summarize(`Block Count` = n()) |> 
  mutate(Grade = replace_na(Grade, "Missing")) |> 
  mutate(`Percentage of Census Blocks` = (`Block Count` / sum(`Block Count`)) * 100)

# Convert the data frame to a table using gt()
la_block_groups |> 
  gt()
```

geom_col()
summarize, take mean, mean on Y, abcd on X 

```{r}
# Summarize average conditions by grade & visualize
avg_low_inc <- la_redline |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  group_by(grade) |> 
  drop_na(grade) |> 
  summarise(avg_pct_low_inc = mean(LOWINCPCT, na.rm = TRUE))

avg_pm25 <- la_redline |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  group_by(grade) |> 
  drop_na(grade) |> 
  summarise(avg_pct_pm25 = mean(P_PM25, na.rm = TRUE))

avg_life_exp <-  la_redline |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  group_by(grade) |> 
  drop_na(grade) |> 
  summarise(avg_pct_life_exp = mean(LIFEEXPPCT, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(
  data = avg_low_inc,
  mapping = aes(
    x = grade,
    y = avg_pct_low_inc, 
    fill = grade
  )
) + 
geom_col() + 
theme_bw() +
labs(x = "HOLC grade", y = "Mean percent low income", title = "Percent low income by HOLC grade")

ggplot(
  data = avg_pm25,
  mapping = aes(
    x = grade,
    y = avg_pct_pm25, 
    fill = grade
  )
) + 
geom_col() + 
theme_bw() +
labs(x = "HOLC grade", y = "Mean percent PM 2.5", title = "Percent PM 2.5 by HOLC grade")

ggplot(
  data = avg_life_exp,
  mapping = aes(
    x = grade,
    y = avg_pct_life_exp, 
    fill = grade
  )
) + 
geom_col() + 
theme_bw() +
labs(x = "HOLC grade", y = "Mean percent low life expectancy", title = "Percent low life expectancy by HOLC grade")
```

# Part 2

## Objective
Explore the legacy of historical redlining in Los Angeles on the report of pedestrian and bike crashes/ fatalities.

## Import data

```{r}
# Read in crashes data, and inspect lat/long columns
crash_test <- read_csv(here::here("eds223-hw2", "data", "SWITRS_LA", "crashes.csv"))
sum(is.na(crash_test$POINT_X))
sum(is.na(crash_test$POINT_Y))
sum(is.na(crash_test$LATITUDE))
sum(is.na(crash_test$LONGITUDE))

# Drop nas, set crs to match that of ejscreen data. Use POINT_X and POINT_Y as the lat/long (as it has far fewer NAs than the LAT and LONG columns), convert df to sf 
crashes <- read_csv(here::here("eds223-hw2", "data", "SWITRS_LA", "crashes.csv")) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  drop_na(POINT_X) |> 
  drop_na(POINT_Y) |> 
  rename(long = POINT_X,
          lat = POINT_Y) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) |> 
  st_transform(crs = 3857)
```

## Visualize data

```{r}
# Join redline data with crash data
redline_crashes <- st_join(crashes, la_redline)

# Select relevant columns from crash data 
filtered_redline_crash <- redline_crashes |> 
  mutate(
    grade = ifelse(is.na(grade), "No HOLC Grade", grade)
  ) |> 
  select(grade, long, lat, PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT, BICYCLE_ACCIDENT, COUNT_PED_KILLED, COUNT_BICYCLIST_KILLED) |> 
  mutate(
    PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT = ifelse(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT == "Y", 1, 0),
    BICYCLE_ACCIDENT = ifelse(BICYCLE_ACCIDENT == "Y", 1, 0)
  )

```
